verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a fair question for a SaaS work platform with a developer ecosystem, so the axis applies, but the evidence pack never mentions one. The closest items are a developer MCP for scaffolding and promoting versions from chat, plus a GraphQL API and SDKs. Those are adjacent surfaces or building blocks, not a command-line tool, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
